subject: Re: Clearleaf — demo time and ownership?
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jordan.k@clearleaf.io>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Clearleaf / Redwood — quick demo booked via site

Hi Mateo / Ava,

I signed up for a trial yesterday and booked a demo slot through the self-serve calendar (attached screenshot and .ics). I just got an outreach from an SDR and now I have two calendar notices for overlapping times. Can we consolidate? Prefer to keep the call next Wednesday but can move if needed.

A couple quick context points:
- We're evaluating inference cost and routing; team of 3 (infra, eng, product) will attend
- Security is important — need SOC2 evidence later in the process

Please let me know who will own the meeting so I know who to expect.

Thanks,
Jordan Klein
Head of Platform
Clearleaf Inc

Attachments: signup-calendar.ics (calendar invite), clearleaf-signup-screenshot.png (screenshot of confirmation)

Thanks for the note Jordan — I can take the scheduled slot and run a 30-min intro + quick product walkthrough. Mateo — I see the self-serve signup landed in your mailbox as well.

Plan I suggest:
- Keep the original self-serve time (Wed 10:00am ET) to avoid churn
- I will cover product fit + quick Q&A; if they want deeper infra discussion we'll loop in an AE/solutions follow-up

Jordan — if you can confirm attendee list (names + emails) I will keep the invite and send a short agenda.

Ava Chen
SDR, Redwood Inference

Looping in here — per territory mapping Clearleaf is assigned to my AE queue (Eastern Enterprise). We typically have the AE lead the first demo when the account is already flagged as enterprise (security asks + eval runway).

I just pulled the HubSpot record — looks like marketing sent nurture and the org-level score triggered the AE flow. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543.

Suggested approach:
- Ben (AE) to own the call as primary — will cover business and procurement questions
- Ava to join as SDR for intro and quick product highlights (handshake)
- Mateo — can you take the meeting notification into your mailbox calendar and mark 'tentative' for the self-serve slot so Jordan sees a single invite?

Ben Carter

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.k@clearleaf.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 17:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Clearleaf / Redwood — demo time and ownership? (handshake)

Thanks for flagging — quick reconcile from my side and a proposed small playbook so Jordan sees a single, clean experience: 

1) Ownership: Ben — AE will be primary for this account given enterprise signals and procurement questions. Ben, please start the meeting and cover business + procurement.
2) Handshake: Ava — please join as SDR and run the initial 5–7 minute context/agenda and demo high-level product fit.
3) Calendar: Jordan — we'll consolidate into the self-serve invite time (Wed, 10:00am ET). Ben will move to that slot; Ava and I will accept. If that time absolutely doesn't work for you we can reschedule — propose Thu 11:00am ET as fallback.
4) Prep: Ben — can you paste the HubSpot deal link and any procurement checklist items into the shared agenda doc? Ava — please add a 3-slide intro deck + attendee list. I've created a short agenda doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x-example-mpa

Jordan — confirming attendee list would be great so we can lock the invite. Apologies for the cross-contact; we'll make sure you only see one invite and one point of contact moving forward.

—Mateo
Head of SDR Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
